描述_EN: each is surmounted by a standing image of the popular deity, guanyin, helping humans overcome wordly difficulties. four panels are bordered by an integrally woven key-fret pattern and four by an animal scroll. set of eight panels of silk tapestry (kesi), possibly hangings or from a screen. woven with scenes from the jâtaka stories.
描述_ZN: 每幅的上方都有一个受欢迎的观音菩萨的立像，帮助人类克服文字上的困难。 四个板块的边缘是一个整体编织的钥匙扣图案，四个是一个动物卷轴。 一套八幅的丝织品，可能是挂件或屏风的。 织有jâtaka故事的场景。
